desc:
Welcome to Tom and Jerry Seek! 🧀😺

How to play:
🧀 Grab all the cheese around the map before time runs out!
🥤 Use holes to hide from the cat and dodge his tricks.
⏰ When you hear those paws getting closer... you better run!!

Keep moving and don't get caught! Can you help Jerry safely get his cheese? 

If you enjoyed the game, make sure to 👍 Like, ⭐ Favorite, and 🔔 Follow!
💰 Buying gamepasses really helps support the game! 💰
